scope: Bounded read-only audit of already-configured local and cluster compute. No model download, installation, job submission, cloud allocation, or inference was performed.

decision.reason: Wuzhen still holds the pinned Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M artifact and llama.cpp executable, but the executable is CPU-only and has no HIP/CUDA/HSA linkage. The prior bounded pilot was stopped after a core semantic failure and did not pass the frozen validator. Scheduler-visible DCUs therefore do not constitute a working LLM extraction route. Kunshan's direct SSH authentication could not be refreshed in this audit, and the latest sealed Kunshan probe found neither a runtime nor cached model there.

frozen_route_constraints.hardware_constraint: Wuzhen advertises Hygon DCUs, but the existing llama.cpp binary was not built with an accelerator backend and prior logs explicitly reported no usable GPU.
frozen_route_constraints.quality_constraint: The completed pilot bound experience duration to the wrong object and had other material classification/omission errors. Faster hardware would not remove this production-quality failure.
frozen_route_constraints.conclusion: Existing cluster accelerators cannot presently execute the frozen extraction through a verified, approved runtime.

minimal_aws_information_if_a_new_route_i.accelerator: Existing service/instance type, GPU model and usable VRAM; no instance-size recommendation or purchase yet.
minimal_aws_information_if_a_new_route_i.runtime: Existing model endpoint or installed inference runtime, if any; frozen extraction quality must not be assumed to transfer across models.
minimal_aws_information_if_a_new_route_i.access: SSH command and local key path, or existing service configuration location; no credentials in Git.
minimal_aws_information_if_a_new_route_i.cost_control: Existing resource/credit constraints and intended region; quantify additional use before requesting a new paid allocation.
minimal_aws_information_if_a_new_route_i.quality_gate: Do not recreate the rejected Qwen8B baseline. A materially different model route needs a bounded comparison using already available validation sources, not a new corpus-cleaning cycle.

disclaimer: GPT/Sol execution is an OpenAI-hosted service path and is not running on, or attributed to, these cluster DCUs or any rented AWS GPU.

root_route_decision.reason: A GPU does not remedy the previously observed measurement errors. Do not consume remaining DCU hours reproducing a failed extraction route. First identify the user existing AWS service/hardware and available model runtime; no capacity or cost promise before inspection.
